defect.description: The frozen CLI calls assemble(config) before stage dispatch. That routine parses the external label column before run_external creates its development-only seal, so the original wording that outcomes were not accessed before sealing is not literally supported.
defect.scientific_effect: No external labels enter development model selection, refit, calibration, or prediction, but the I/O chronology and its provenance wording require correction.
defect.hard_stop_rule: Do not run the frozen external-retrospective CLI path for V4.

runtime_shim.scope: Reuse the frozen development-only fitting, checkpoint, metric, bootstrap, prediction, and stage-manifest functions; read external covariates without label; seal development-only predictions and hashes; parse and evaluate external outcomes only after the seal exists.
runtime_shim.retrospective_boundary: Historical outcome viewing remains declared. This is retrospective and data-informed, not prospective or preregistered.

acceptance_rule: Run only after internal-primary completes. Require strict seal creation before outcome parsing, validate checkpoint digests, and retain the retrospective-boundary wording in every manuscript claim.
